{{Top|leg}}
A '''space elevator''' was a structure that could transport [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] or material from the surface of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], into [[Realspace/Legends|outer space]] without using [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]]. The [[Quarzite space station/Legends|Quarzite space station]] used this method to travel to and from [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]], as the [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] pressure of their planet surface was so intense it could implode starships upon entry.

The [[Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[Skyhook Platform|Core Worlds Engineering Skyhook Platforms]], such as the infamous Black Sun leader Prince Xizor's personal skyhook ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'', were considered to be space elevators in terms of function.<ref name="TSoSWSotE">''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''</ref>
